<title level="1" right="Rules">[Grafting Rules](/Rules.aspx?ID=3275)</title>

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 97

<row gap="medium">
<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">
Grafts are living tissues that are implanted into a host, where they integrate with the hosts’ native biology. To implant a graft, you must be an expert in [Medicine](/Skills.aspx?ID=42) and have the appropriate formula. Graft formulas can be purchased as outlined in the [formulas rules](/Rules.aspx?ID=2214).

You can take the [Graft Technician](/Feats.aspx?ID=5542) feat to implant grafts.
</column>

<column gap="medium">

</column>

</row>
